releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.1.14

Hubble 1.1.14: make Status Log a copyable live activity list

Status Log now presents timestamped, selectable plain-text lines with Copy log, automatic pause while selecting or scrolling, and live resume. Filter all activity, background processes, or user actions, then narrow by source and search text.

The log now includes startup, workspace changes and saves, configuration import/export, module health, routing, tally controls, and Companion layout/preset operations alongside button execution and connection diagnostics. Existing retained history and filtered JSONL export remain available.
